headline: Strong Order Pipeline, ADS Expansion & Diversification Support Growth

highlights: Result Update 09th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 4,880 Sansera Engineering Ltd Auto Ancillary 1 Strong Order Pipeline, ADS Expansion & Diversification Support Growth Est.

Recommendation Rationale • ADS Growth & Order Visibility Strengthen Long-Term Outlook: Sansera’s ADS business continues to witness strong traction, supported by rising demand across aerospace, semiconductors and defence.
The 5-year executable ADS order backlog increased to Rs 5,870 Cr from Rs 4,440 Cr in Q1FY27, providing strong revenue visibility.
Capacity expansion, including a new 1.2 Lc sq. ft. facility and a dedicated defence unit, will support the next phase of growth.
